scope: Text services, shaping/layout/raster, font faces/providers/cache, VisualTempText and TempText. Source-level review and contract execution, not a formal equivalence proof.

corrected_source_semantics.correction: Read-only live view preserves observed updates and does not expose mutation around dirty/cache APIs.
ref readonly source exposes current FaceIndex while an ordinary copied value remains independent.
Font metrics/cache/trim helpers and bitmap format retain caller sentinels on source early failures; successful reset branches remain reset.

Font names, support override keys, source identity, style family lists, span/run languages, Unicode service result/dictionary arguments and OpenType tags retain original bytes. Owning setters copy caller storage.
TempText.TextStyle assignment copies the source value; later edits to the widget-owned mutable style remain allowed.
TextLayoutSpanId default/arrays expose invalid all-ones Value and source TextFloatRange float equality treats NaN as unequal.
Source numeric/table/name failure outputs preserved, catalog is a borrowed read-only view, source String API boundaries retain bytes. Implemented by structure agent.

language_and_platform_boundaries: Source scalar and UTF-8 byte indices are explicit; no UTF-16 source-index substitution.
Source String data, including font source keys, metadata, family lists, languages and Unicode service results, keeps exact UTF-8 bytes; owning assignments copy while StringView returns borrow.
C++ const TextStyle borrows map to live ReadOnlyTextStyle with live read-only list views; Copy explicitly creates editable values. TempText style assignment retains its own copy.
FontFace.Source is a ref-readonly live borrow; failure paths only change ref outputs where the source changes them.
TextLayoutSpanId uses an internal offset encoding so CLR default and array elements expose the original all-ones invalid Value; TextFloatRange equality uses source float ==, including NaN.
HarfBuzz/ICU objects retain pinned UTF-16/face buffers for the full original native lifetime.

Explicit detach/dispose resource order follows the source. Last-reference C++ RC destruction is represented by managed shared references and native-holder finalizers; GC collection timing is not synchronous RC timing.
OpenTypeTagToName returns owned exact four-byte Utf8StringView, including non-UTF8 tags.
System font provider dispatch is platform-specific; macOS path is compile-checked only on Windows.
